note: vibrance weights its boost by s instead of 1 - s, so saturated pixels move most, caught by ColorAdjustTests.lowSaturationMovesMost
vibrance drops the skin damping, so skin hues move as much as others, caught by ColorAdjustTests.skinMovesHalf
hsl range weights take the cosine over one neighbour's span on both sides, so they no longer sum to 1, caught by ColorAdjustTests.rangeWeightsSumToOne
hsl range hue taken as degrees instead of percent of a 30 degree turn, caught by ColorAdjustTests.hslHueIsPercentOfThirtyDegrees
hsl range lightness dropped, caught by ColorAdjustTests.rangeHueAndLightness
hsl grey pass-through guard removed, so greys take the reds shift, caught by ColorAdjustTests.rangeHueAndLightness
vibrance negative branch flipped, so -100 doubles chroma, caught by ColorAdjustTests.vibranceNegativeAndCapped
vibrance gamut cap toward black removed, so a channel goes below 0, caught by ColorAdjustTests.vibranceNegativeAndCapped
